HC-SR501 PIR 센서의 출력을 D7(EXTI)로 받아, 사람이 움: Read the output of an HC-SR501 PIR sensor on D7 (EXTI); when a person moves, turn on the LED on D6 and log the time.
PIR 센서가 적외선의 '변화'를 감지한다는 것을 안다: Know that a PIR sensor detects a 'change' in infrared
모듈의 유지 시간, 차단 시간, 워밍업을 설명한다: Explain the module's hold time, block time and warm-up
양쪽 에지 인터럽트로 시작과 끝을 모두 잡는다: Catch both the start and the end with a both-edges interrupt
센서와 LED 연결: Connect the sensor and the LED
**PIR**(수동 적외선) 센서는 사람 몸에서 나오는 적외선이 **바뀌: A **PIR** (passive infrared) sensor detects **changes** in the infrared coming from a human body. Someone standing still is not detected.
모듈이 판단을 다 하고 OUT을 3.3 V로 올려 주므로 MCU는 디지털: The module makes the decision itself and raises OUT to 3.3 V, so the MCU only has to watch a digital input. It does need 5 V power (4.5–20 V), though.
**▶ 실행**하면 3초 동안 **워밍업**(감지 안 함)한 뒤 준비됩니: Press **▶ Run**: it **warms up** for 3 seconds (no detection) and then is ready. Drag the person figure through the fan-shaped area, or change the **Motion** value to 1.
LED가 켜지고 콘솔에 `motion detected (#1) - LED: The LED turns on and the console shows `motion detected (#1) - LED on`. It turns off after the hold time (3 s).
Grading moves the person at 3.6 s, after the warm-up (it runs for 6 seconds).
모듈의 시간들: **유지 시간**(Tx 가변저항, OUT이 High로 있: The module's timings: **hold time** (the Tx potentiometer; how long OUT stays High), **block time** (no detection for about 2.5 s after returning Low),
**워밍업**(전원을 넣고 30–60초, 여기선 3초). 펌웨어는 EXT: **warm-up** (30–60 s after power-on, 3 s here). The firmware sets EXTI on both edges and logs both the start and end times.
LED가 안 켜지면 VCC가 5V인지(3V3에서는 동작하지 않음) 보세요: If the LED doesn't light, check that VCC is 5V (it doesn't work on 3V3).
감지하면 LED가 켜짐: LED turns on when motion is detected
